status: Authored design proposal only. Numbers are starting hypotheses, not observed yields or balance.
cost_rule: All facility costs are incremental; prerequisites are permanent and mandatory; recipes spend per output/operation.

buildings.name: Armory
buildings.benefit: Issue actual secured equipment into fresh heroes, across all native-compatible slots and item classes whose transfer adapter is supported. Personal lending and guild loans retain title.

buildings.name: Quartermaster's annex
buildings.benefit: Pre-position an actual alternate loadout or support chest at a compatible field service before launch. Recipients can rearm there under native equipment/action rules; requires WAY1 for branch-side delivery.

buildings.name: Smithy
buildings.benefit: Craft ordinary starting bases and raise compatible weapons/armour to +2, subject to a lower native maximum. Study eligible ordinary patterns.

buildings.name: Runic forge
buildings.benefit: Craft heavier bases, apply studied elemental brands/resistance egos, improve ordinary weapons to +5 and armour to min(+4, native maximum), and produce supported cooperative devices.

buildings.name: Masterworks foundry
buildings.benefit: Improve ordinary weapons to native +9 and armour to its native maximum; produce studied resistance rings, holy-wrath work and an astral beacon. No generic unrand duplication.

buildings.name: Scriptorium
buildings.benefit: Archive valid field-acquired spell research; expose archived level 1-3 spells to future members' run libraries and support basic pattern study.

buildings.name: Arcane archive
buildings.benefit: Expose archived level 1-6 spells and enable phase-swap/rallying scroll production, advanced device patterns and FOR3.

buildings.name: Grand library
buildings.benefit: Expose all archived legal spell levels and enable shared-vigour scroll production. Native XL, spell levels, MP, failure and religion still apply.

buildings.name: Drill yard
buildings.benefit: Each fresh hero chooses one permanent curriculum: selected primary/secondary/tertiary skill floors 3/2/1.

buildings.name: Company academy
buildings.benefit: Upgrade the chosen curriculum to skill floors 5/3/2; enable aegis-standard and rallying preparations with their other facilities.

buildings.name: War college
buildings.benefit: Upgrade the chosen curriculum to skill floors 8/5/3, making inherited heavier equipment and planned hybrids practical earlier.

buildings.name: Herbarium
buildings.benefit: Produce finite curing/heal-wounds supplies from personally or guild-funded inputs; guild-wide recipe access.

buildings.name: Company apothecary
buildings.benefit: Produce resistance and empathy potions, supporting shared survival and planned branch preparation.

buildings.name: Alchemical conservatory
buildings.benefit: Produce soul ambrosia and, with LIB3, shared-vigour scrolls. Powerful finite party recovery competes for rare inputs.

buildings.name: Branch lodges
buildings.benefit: Enable safe deposit and individual extraction contacts in compatible Lair/Orc entrance generation; accept ARM2 pre-positioned actual stock.

buildings.name: Supply network
buildings.benefit: Add compatible S-branch/Elf/Vaults/Depths entrance contacts and dispatch new declared consignments after launch. Delivery commits at eligible service use, without an offline travel timer.

buildings.name: Expedition staging network
buildings.benefit: Enable authored extended staging contacts and portable-return-beacon logistics; access does not change native branch entry or make an occupied service safe.

buildings.name: Recovery lodge
buildings.benefit: Dispatch salvage into a valid closed-expedition recovery site and, with LIB1, produce soul-recall scrolls. Native ordinary revival remains available independently.

buildings.name: Field recovery office
buildings.benefit: Produce sealed caskets protecting up to 40 tagged material units for salvage and, with FOR3, an astral beacon. Protected cargo remains exposed until actually recovered.

buildings.name: Soul anchor infirmary
buildings.benefit: Produce finite inheritance tethers: bind an eligible real equipment instance for automatic return only after its source expedition finally closes.

buildings.name: Ward workshop
buildings.benefit: Produce single-scroll heat seals and single-potion thermal ampoules for scoped Gehenna/Cocytus exceptions before a first Hell clear.

buildings.name: Infernal laboratory
buildings.benefit: Produce charged corrosion frames and ritual wards with explicit same-floor support auras; protection is finite and non-stacking.

buildings.name: Planar observatory
buildings.benefit: Produce/recharge anchored return beacons; WAY3 supplies the field logistics required to deploy them for separate hero or cargo departures.

recipes.name: Spear
recipes.rule: Native wield/anatomy rules; no random brand.

recipes.name: Long sword
recipes.rule: Native wield/anatomy rules.

recipes.name: Quarterstaff
recipes.rule: Supports a caster/melee opening; normal hands and skill requirements.

recipes.name: Buckler
recipes.rule: A low-cost protective loan for a new member.

recipes.name: Leather armour
recipes.rule: Native encumbrance and anatomy.

recipes.name: Chain mail
recipes.rule: Useful with trained protection; does not remove encumbrance.

recipes.name: Kite shield
recipes.rule: Ordinary base; cannot fabricate the Aegis of Fellowship.

recipes.name: Weapon enchant I
recipes.rule: Result at most +2; do not lower an already stronger weapon.

recipes.name: Weapon enchant II
recipes.rule: Use only for resulting +3 through +5.

recipes.name: Weapon enchant III
recipes.rule: Use only for resulting +6 through native +9.

recipes.name: Armour enchant I
recipes.rule: Result at most min(+2, armour_max_enchant).

recipes.name: Armour enchant II
recipes.rule: Use for resulting +3/+4, within native maximum.

recipes.name: Armour enchant III
recipes.rule: Use for resulting +5 or greater, within native maximum.

recipes.name: Venom application
recipes.input: Eligible unbranded ordinary weapon; venom pattern known
recipes.rule: No artifact mutation; keep enchantment/identity.

recipes.name: Flaming application
recipes.input: Eligible unbranded ordinary weapon; flaming pattern known
recipes.rule: No artifact mutation; preserve legal base/brand combinations.

recipes.name: Freezing application
recipes.input: Eligible unbranded ordinary weapon; freezing pattern known
recipes.rule: Same legal-base rules as BR02.

recipes.name: Holy wrath application
recipes.input: Eligible unbranded ordinary weapon; holy-wrath pattern known
recipes.rule: Native religion/species/use rules remain; no universal holy conversion.

recipes.name: Fire-resistance ego
recipes.input: Eligible ordinary unegoed armour; pattern known
recipes.output: Same item with native fire-resistance ego
recipes.rule: Use native ego compatibility; cannot stack egos.

recipes.name: Cold-resistance ego
recipes.input: Eligible ordinary unegoed armour; pattern known
recipes.output: Same item with native cold-resistance ego
recipes.rule: Use native ego compatibility; cannot stack egos.

recipes.name: Poison-resistance ego
recipes.input: Eligible ordinary unegoed armour; pattern known
recipes.output: Same item with native poison-resistance ego
recipes.rule: Use native ego compatibility; cannot stack egos.

recipes.name: Fire-resistance ring
recipes.output: One ordinary ring of protection from fire
recipes.rule: Native ring property; no random artifact extras.

recipes.name: Cold-resistance ring
recipes.output: One ordinary ring of protection from cold
recipes.rule: Native ring property; no random artifact extras.

recipes.name: Poison-resistance ring
recipes.output: One ordinary ring of poison resistance
recipes.rule: Native ring property; no random artifact extras.

recipes.name: Curing
recipes.rule: Use native effect/eligibility; consumed once.

recipes.name: Heal wounds
recipes.rule: Use native effect/eligibility; consumed once.

recipes.name: Resistance
recipes.rule: Finite group preparation; one potion is not a per-member grant.

recipes.name: Empathy
recipes.rule: Use native party healing/damage bond, with its actual eligibility/scope.

recipes.name: Soul ambrosia
recipes.rule: Strong native party regeneration/revival; requires exact scope/lifecycle audit.

recipes.name: Rallying
recipes.rule: Native same-floor formation/control/support operation.

recipes.name: Phase swap
recipes.rule: Native compatible same-floor ally swap.

recipes.name: Soul recall
recipes.rule: Current native code revives downed slots across floors, or recalls separated living peers. Exclude fallen/extracted heroes; characterize consent and destination restrictions before campaign use.

recipes.name: Shared vigour
recipes.rule: Native same-floor party restoration; exact eligible effect remains native.

recipes.name: Aegis standard
recipes.rule: XP evoker; current native use requires a visible living same-floor ally. Preserve recharge debt.

recipes.name: Twin-spark conduit
recipes.rule: XP evoker; visible living same-floor ally needed; preserve native attack/friendly-fire rules.

recipes.name: Astral beacon
recipes.rule: XP evoker; visible same-floor living ally or downed ghost needed. Complete auxiliary-state transfer required.

recipes.name: Consignment packaging
recipes.input: Actual declared gear/supplies; transferred, not consumed
recipes.rule: Before-launch reserve delivery; WAY2 enables a new post-launch shipment. Destination/source title and native receiving capacity remain explicit.

recipes.name: Sealed recovery casket
recipes.input: Up to 40 tagged field material units; sealed, not donated
recipes.rule: Preserve all contents into salvage escrow on final source closure; no automatic banking. Casket consumed on settlement/recovery.

recipes.name: Inheritance tether
recipes.input: One eligible physical equipment instance; bound, retained
recipes.rule: Return remaining actual item only on final source closure. Exclude quest items/stacks/consumables; no early copy or consumed-item restoration.

recipes.name: Heat seal
recipes.input: One actual scroll; retained until read
recipes.rule: Bypass only Gehenna's branch read prohibition once; other read restrictions remain. Consume seal on successful scroll consumption.

recipes.name: Thermal ampoule
recipes.input: One actual potion; retained until drunk
recipes.rule: Bypass only Cocytus's branch drink prohibition once; other drinking restrictions remain. Consume on successful potion use.

recipes.name: Corrosion frame
recipes.rule: One cell grants 60 aut: same-floor living visible allies within radius 2 get Dis's fixed corrosion contribution reduced 8 to 4. No protection from other corrosion; strongest source only.

recipes.name: Ritual ward
recipes.rule: One cell grants 60 aut: same-floor living visible allies within radius 2 use 3/4 rather than 1/2 Will for Tartarus alone. Nonbranch lowered-Will still imposes native 1/2; strongest source only.

recipes.name: Ward cell
recipes.rule: Evocation takes one normal 10-aut action; follows bearer across floor travel with remaining duration. Disconnect/hand-off/reload never reset it.

recipes.name: Anchored return beacon
recipes.rule: Three consecutive 10-aut activation actions at an eligible safe site. After activation, each hero extraction or cargo-only settlement consumes one charge. Remaining peers continue; no remote cargo.

recipes.name: Return-beacon recharge
recipes.input: One actual beacon at guild service; retained
recipes.rule: Only at an eligible guild service, never on the ground during a fight; no extra benefit from charging a full beacon.

recipes.name: Brand / ego pattern study
recipes.input: One identified eligible field-acquired ordinary item; consumed
recipes.rule: Application still requires the recipe's Forge tier. No artifact cloning or starter/import research faucet.

recipes.name: Resistance ring study
recipes.input: One identified field-acquired ordinary resistance ring; consumed
recipes.rule: Choose keeping the useful ring versus investing it in repeatable production.

yield_profiles.basis: One fully collected segment before loss; 30 common material units.

yield_profiles.segment: Rune approach / Vaults segment (Elf is an alternate)
yield_profiles.basis: Incremental to preceding segments; 104 units. One route leg, not a separate payment for every named branch.
154 common units plus at most one authored special-component acquisition; content/generation must explicitly support it.
